notes: Versioned, licence-free reference sentences. Audio is synthesised on the benchmark Mac with `say` so runs are reproducible and identical for every engine; real-speech runs use the same sentences read aloud. Accents come from the voices; the noisy set adds white noise to the first voice at `noise.snrDecibels`. Never add dictated user content.
